$comment: The colour theme picker: Settings → Theme (app/(tabs)/settings/theme.tsx) and the theme step of the welcome flow (components/ThemePicker.tsx).

title.note: Settings row and screen title; the colour theme of the app.

footer: Every theme has a light and a dark side: Automatic follows the iPhone, Light and Dark keep to one. The app icon changes with the theme.

light.note: VoiceOver label of the light-mode preview tile of a theme.

dark.note: VoiceOver label of the dark-mode preview tile of a theme.

appearance.$comment: Settings → Theme, a segmented control above the list: whether the theme follows the iPhone's light/dark setting or stays on one side.

auto.note: Follow the iPhone's appearance. Segment label; keep short.

light.note: Always the light side. Segment label.

dark.note: Always the dark side. Segment label.

name.$comment: Theme names. Brand names of the editor themes they come from: keep them as they are, except the app's own.

graphite.note: The default theme: graphite grey on off-white (and the reverse in dark mode). Translate the colour name.
